samples.scene: A monk in a brown robe stands in a stone hall with tall arched windows and a long wooden bench.
A girl stands on a wooden stool, one arm stretched high, lifting a jar down from a high shelf.
A child stands alone on a straight row of identical round stepping stones, holding one crooked bent stone out to the side.
A person stands at a wooden podium, one hand flat on a torn paper sheet, the other hand pointing down at it.
A person in a spacesuit stands on a launch pad, one hand on a ladder, looking up at a closed rocket hatch.
A child stands on a dock holding a suitcase, looking at a large ship on the water.
A boy stands at the edge of a cliff, one arm stretched out, looking down at a steep drop below.
An empty wooden school desk and chair in a bare classroom, a single closed notebook resting on the desktop.
An empty wooden school chair and desk in a classroom, a backpack hanging on the chair back, no person.
A child stands with both arms stretched straight out to the sides, holding a long ruler level in one hand, in a plain room.
A child kneels on a bathroom floor, pressing a thick sponge onto a puddle of spilled water.
A man stands over a small crouching dog, holding a raised rolled newspaper in one hand.
A child in a school uniform stands on stone steps holding a book, facing a large building with columns and a wide doorway.
A boy on a bicycle leans forward, gripping the handlebars, riding fast along a straight road.
A young girl stands at the front of a classroom, one hand raised near her mouth, a small flag held in her other hand.
A girl stands with both hands holding a wrapped gift box, arms stretched forward, in a bright room.
A boy stands at a wooden door, one hand on the handle, a key held up in his other hand.
A boy sits on the ground beside a fallen bicycle, one hand on the bent front wheel, a cracked helmet beside him.
A girl stands in a wide hotel room, holding a small suitcase in one hand, a bed and a window behind her.
A girl walks beside a woman on a park path, both facing forward, the girl holding the woman's hand.
